name: Christina Pomk
original_name: クリスティナ・ポマク
source:
A woman who came to visit [url=/c13614/]Shuugo[/url] from far away overseas.
For some reason she knows about Shuugo, and since she has no one to go to, she ends up working at Tachibana Kanko.
After losing her father when she was young she lived alone with her mother, but due to certain circumstances she disappeared.
For some reason, she has a lot of feelings about Shuugo.

She dreams of meeting Shuugo and teaches herself Japanese, but she is still only able to speak in broken words.
Although she has a shy personality, she will open up to anyone she falls in love with even once.
Since long ago, she has been thinking about Shuugo, who she had never met, since she found out about his existence due to certain circumstances.
She no longer refers to Shuugo as "Shuugo".

[Edited from the [url=http://www.waffle1999.com/game/18bus/chara_04c.htm]official website[/url]]
